groups.defect: The admin/owner authorization expression uses &&, incorrectly denying team admins who do not also satisfy the owner check.
groups.rationale: All four report the same authorization expression. Changing that expression resolves their shared defect; skipping queries for absent teams is only an additional fix recommendation.

groups.defect: Case-sensitive email comparisons allow blacklist bypasses and duplicate attendees, while missing server-side input deduplication and concurrency protection also allow duplicate inserts.
groups.rationale: The blacklist reports overlap with reports of case-sensitive attendee matching, which connect to the broader duplicate-insertion report. s_aed18a73 mentions changing the email argument only within its proposed fix, so that does not connect this group to the email-notification group.

groups.defect: Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests misclassifies existing attendees as newly added email recipients, and the email catch discards the actual error details.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same incorrect argument to sendAddGuestsEmails. s_ff822a38 additionally reports lost error details, which the merged comment must preserve.

groups.defect: The always-truthy error message prevents the fallback and can display an undefined code; validation state and guest inputs also persist across edits, successful submissions, or dialog dismissal.
groups.rationale: All three report the unreachable error-message fallback. s_b459ede8 also reports stale validation and input state, requiring additional fixes in the merged comment.
